briefdescription.para: CRC-protected (optionally redundant) data containers with integrity guaranteed by construction.

detaileddescription.para:
A safe container bundles a user payload with an integrity tag (CRC), an optional inverted shadow copy, and a per-container mutex. All access goes through operations that hold the lock across the whole read-modify-write and reseal the tag automatically, so a stale tag or a torn update cannot happen by construction.
